name: moe_m128_bm16_bn32_v1
hypothesis: Isolate BN32 under the proven BM16 schedule for the M128 W2 tile; preserve all other routes and exact arithmetic.
decision_reason: All tests passed, but the M128 BM16xBN32 W2 tile regressed the aggregate score. Verify-16 rose to 303.6 us from 222.9 us; the W2 kernel profile was 171.6 us versus 68.7 us. Reject BN32 and do not integrate it.
